title: Set represented by an interval
statement: Associate to each real interval the corresponding subset of $\mathbb R$: the whole line for the whole-line interval; the ray below its upper endpoint for a lower ray, including the endpoint exactly when it is closed; the ray above its lower endpoint for an upper ray, including the endpoint exactly when it is closed; and the interval between the two endpoints for a bounded interval, including each endpoint exactly when that endpoint is closed.
